units.source_text: 母后想道：“哎呀，这真可怕了！

en.t: Her mother thought, "Oh no, this is truly frightening!

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御心肠太狠，桐壶更衣分明是被她折磨死的。

en.t: The Kokiden Consort is far too cruel; the Kiritsubo Intimate was plainly tormented to death by her.

units.source_text: 前车可鉴，真正教人寒心！”

en.t: That warning from the past is enough to learn from; it truly chills the heart!"
She thought it over again and again, unable to make up her mind.

units.source_text: 此事终于不曾顺利进行。

en.t: In the end, the matter never went forward smoothly.

units.source_text: 不料这期间母后患病身死，四公主成了孤苦伶仃之身。

en.t: Unexpectedly, during this time her mother fell ill and died, leaving the Fourth Princess utterly alone and without support.

units.source_text: 皇上诚恳地遣人存问，对她家人说：“教她入宫，我把她当作子女看待吧。”

en.t: The Emperor sincerely sent someone to ask after her and told her family, "Have her come into the palace; I will treat her as one of my own children."

units.source_text: 四公主的侍女们、保护人和其兄兵部卿亲王都想道：“

en.t: The Fourth Princess's attendants, her guardians, and her elder brother, the Prince Minister of War, all thought, "

units.source_text: 与其在此孤苦度日，不如让她入宫，心情也可以宽慰一些。”

en.t: Rather than let her spend her days here in loneliness, it would be better to send her into the palace, where her spirits might be somewhat comforted."
So they sent the Fourth Princess into the palace.

units.source_text: 她住在藤壶院，故称为藤壶女御。

en.t: She lived in the Fujitsubo apartments, and so she was called the Fujitsubo Consort.
